title: Ghost traffic telemetry and auto-rollback simulator
creator: Lena Ortiz
description:
Problem: Customers running canary/A-B rollouts and shadow traffic have limited tools to validate functional parity and risk before full cutover. Current console views surface metric deltas but do not simulate rollback outcomes or reconcile shadow traffic divergences to surface actionable root causes.

Goal: Add a Ghost Traffic Telemetry surface (a per-route, timeline-first panel) in Console that: 1) consolidates shadow/ghost traffic traces, per-token and per-request deltas, and cohort-level diff views; 2) provides a deterministic 'Rollback Simulator' that runs historical traffic through candidate fallback policies to predict service-level and cost impact; 3) surfaces regression hypotheses with suggested probe prompts and trace links for quick debugging.

Scope: Console UI + backend telemetry pipelines + lightweight simulation engine. Deliverables: telemetry schema extension, Console panel (Ghost Traffic Timeline + Cohort Delta Table + Rollback Simulator), SDK/API for exporting cohort snapshots, instrumentation docs, and an initial runbook for support teams.
acceptance_criteria: Ghost Traffic Timeline shows per-route shadow vs primary request counts, average latency, token-level divergence rate, and a 7-day trend with zoom-in to hour granularity.

Cohort Delta Table lists statistically significant deltas for configured metrics (latency P95, error rate, hallucination divergence score) with confidence intervals and links to representative traces.

Rollback Simulator can replay a 1-hour historical traffic window through two fallback strategies (instant revert and gradual throttled rollback) and produce estimated impact on latency, success rate, and monthly token cost change.
Simulator results are reproducible and can be exported as a snapshot for postmortem or customer reporting.
Console exposes an API to pull cohort snapshots and simulation outputs for automation or downstream dashboards.
Telemetry ingestion meets retention and privacy policies (PII stripped; KMS-encrypted storage if on Private deployments).
engineering_notes: Backend will extend the existing rollout telemetry schema to tag 'ghost' vs 'primary' requests and include per-token divergence markers from our eval hooks.
KV cache behavior needs consideration: shadow requests currently bypass cache in some customers; simulation must model both cached and uncached paths.
Simulator will be a best-effort deterministic runner; exact match to live rollback impossible but useful for relative comparisons.
We should reuse the trace-linking service (ENG-15678) to avoid building new storage paths for traces.
Estimate assumes ENG implements cohort export API (ENG-14233) and runtime adds a small replay hook.
Instrumentation must emit sampling keys so Console can map representative traces back to cohort buckets without full traffic capture.
risks_and_mitigation: High cardinality of per-token telemetry could spike costs — mitigate with sampled token-delta aggregation and adaptive sampling.
Simulator might mispredict customer impact for highly stateful models — mitigate by including a confidence score and flagging configs that are unsupported for accurate simulation.
PII leakage from traces — enforce automatic PII redaction and require KMS for Private deployments before enabling full trace export.
open_questions: What thresholds should mark a divergence as 'actionable' vs 'noise'? (statistical significance + minimum absolute delta?)
Should the Rollback Simulator allow synthetic traffic injection (to stress corner cases) or only replay captured traffic?
What retention window for simulator snapshots is required by customers and legal? default 30 days?
decisions: Ship a first-cut GA without synthetic injection; replay-only simulator to reduce safety surface.
Use 5-minute default aggregation with ability to expand to 1-minute for zoomed windows to balance telemetry volume and UX needs.
Require security review and KMS before enabling trace export in Private deployments.
milestone_checklist: Spec sign-off by PM + Design + ENG (target 2025-02-17)
Console panel basic UI with timeline + delta table (beta)
Simulator MVP implementation and integration tests
Run internal shadow on staging traffic for 72h and validate simulator predictions
